# Sarah

## Overview

- **Age:** eight years old (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P59](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0059)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

- **Family:** [Jane Ann](../character/jane-ann.md) (cousin)

## Appearance

Sarah is a small person who dresses in shabby black garments. By a later point, she is described as a large, sleek, gray-and-white cat possessing an enormous dignity.

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P55](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0055), [v3 ch.Relationships P58](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0058)_

## Personality

Sarah is eight years old and demonstrates notable ability as a mouser. Her skill in catching mice is well recognized.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P59](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0059)_

## History

Miss Sarah [Copp](../character/copp.md) lived at the [Copp](../character/copp.md) home on the [Tory Road](../codex/places.md#tory-road), where she had been forced by her sister Martha to whitewash an old duck house every spring. After [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) fell through the roof of the duck house while trying to look into the pantry, Sarah rescued her and later entertained [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana Wright](../character/diana-wright.md) over tea and bread, selling [Anne](../character/anne.md) a willow-ware platter and announcing her own upcoming marriage. Her father had previously sent away her suitor, Luther Wallace, twenty years earlier because he was poor. In addition, [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) possessed a pet named the Sarah-cat, who had been given to her by her washerwoman and who quickly put the stray cat [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) in his place upon arriving at Patty's Place.

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P2](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0002), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P4](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0004), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P5](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0005), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P6](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0006), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P7](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0007), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P8](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0008), +174 more_
